messages:
maya: Hi team, quick intro  I'm Maya, starting today on infra. Using a Windows laptop (WSL2 Ubuntu) and trying to get a stable dev env. Goal: asdf for node/python/rust, direnv for project envs, and my dotfiles sync. Hitting two issues: 1) asdf-installed node isn't picked up in VS Code remote WSL terminal sometimes; 2) git credential manager on Windows is interfering with SSH keys when I try to push from WSL. Any pointers?

oliver: welcome maya! :wave: For VS Code + WSL, ensure you installed the 'Remote - WSL' extension and reopen the folder in WSL. Also make sure `~/.bashrc` sources `~/.asdf/asdf.sh` and `~/.asdf/completions/asdf.bash`. WSL sometimes launches non-login shells, so put the asdf init into `~/.profile` too.

maya: thanks. I added the asdf init to .bashrc but still seeing `node: command not found` in the VS Code integrated terminal unless I open a new full-shell. Is there a way to avoid reload every time?

tara: we add a small shim to repo root: `.envrc` with `source_env ~/.profile` and we enable direnv in VS Code by installing the 'direnv' extension and setting `terminal.integrated.inheritEnv` to true. That way when direnv loads it exports the path. Also run `direnv allow` after changes.

oliver: if VS Code starts a non-interactive shell, check settings `terminal.integrated.shellArgs.linux`: we set `-l` to force login shell for bash/zsh. Example: `"terminal.integrated.shellArgs.linux": ["-l"]`.

maya: great, that'll help. Now the SSH/key issue: when I `git push` from WSL it prompts for credential manager and pushes via HTTPS using Windows creds, not my SSH key in `~/.ssh`. How do others force SSH from WSL?

kevin: on Windows, the Git for Windows credential manager (GCM) can hijack remote URLs. Two quick fixes: 1) change remote URL to SSH: `git remote set-url origin git@github.com:org/repo.git`, and ensure `ssh-agent` is running in WSL with your key added; or 2) configure git to ignore credential manager in WSL: `git config --global --unset credential.helper` or set `credential.helper` to `store` inside WSL. We usually add `eval $(ssh-agent -s); ssh-add ~/.ssh/id_ed25519` to `~/.profile` in WSL.

maya: tried switching remote to SSH and added key to agent, but VS Code still prompts for password when creating commits with GPG signing enabled. I use `user.signingKey` and want commits signed by my YubiKey plugged into Windows. Any tips forwarding the YubiKey to WSL?

tara: forwarding hardware tokens into WSL is messy. Options: 1) use `gpg --card-status` on Windows and set `gpg.program` in your repo `.gitconfig` to point at Windows gpg via `wslpath`? That's hacky. 2) easier: use remote signing: sign commits on the Windows side (make git in WSL call out to Windows gpg via a wrapper script). We have a small wrapper at `~/.local/bin/gpg-wsl-wrapper` that proxies to `powershell -c "gpg --status-fd 1 --no-tty %*"` and sets `git config --global gpg.program ~/.local/bin/gpg-wsl-wrapper`. Ping me and I can paste it.

maya: oof. Might be easier to disable commit signing for initial setup. Are there any repo-level policies about that?

onboard-bot: Friendly reminder: new-hire checklist requires enabling commit signing or adding your SSH key to the company GitHub org. See https://redwood.example.com/onboarding/keys.

kevin: if you add your SSH pubkey to GitHub, you can skip local GPG for now. Add it via the security invite email or ask me and I can send an invite. For long term, we recommend using the Windows GPG agent and forwarding or using a dedicated hardware workflow on a Linux machine.

maya: thanks all. One more tiny thing: dotfiles. I tried cloning `github.com/redwood/dotfiles` and running `./install` but it errors on `stow` not found. Should I install that on WSL or let asdf/nix handle it?

oliver: install `stow` via apt in WSL (`sudo apt install stow`) or add it to your Nix profile if you use nix. We usually keep dotfiles lightweight: `stow` + symlink strategy. Run `./install --wsl` from the dotfiles repo if it exists; we added that flag last quarter to handle path translations.

maya: installing stow fixed it and dotfiles installed. After doing the SSH key add to GitHub I can push. Thanks everyone — feels much better. Can someone add me to the infra channel?

onboard-bot: Maya added to #infra.

maya: perfect. if anyone has that gpg-wsl-wrapper script handy, please DM or paste here. Appreciate the help :heart:
